verdict.rationale: Earning yield on balances is a fair question for a business account product like Wise Business, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents interest, yield, or any investment feature on held balances. The multi-currency account only covers holding and converting money, and the opt-in FDIC passthrough insurance is an adjacent deposit-protection feature, not yield.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can earn yield on operating cash balances without moving funds to a separate institution
